content.text: In December 2024, the five deals with the highest 90+ arrears rate were CST 2020-1 (4.18%), KOO 2021-2 (3.35%), KOO 2019-2 (3.19%), RED 2023-2 (2.76%) and CST 2019-2 (2.42%). These rates are measured by balance, not by loan count.
